sections.h2: 1. Pick by brightness, not only by price
parts: VANKYO's models range from 150 to 730 lumens on its own spec sheets, and brightness decides how dark the room has to be. The $69.99 Leisure 3W Flip and the $119.99 Leisure 3R Air are 720p and 150 lumens, made for small rooms and dark bedrooms. The H500R and V700 Neo are native 1080p at 330 and 400 ANSI lumens. The V700G Pro is the brightest at 730 ANSI lumens, which the brand pitches for indoor and outdoor use.
Paying $20 to $30 less for a dimmer model is no saving if you end up watching with the lights off every time, so match the lumens to your room first, then apply {code}.
Torn between models? Our [VANKYO H500R vs V700G vs V700G Pro comparison](saving-tips-vankyo-h500r-vs-v700g-vs-v700-pro.html) puts their specs and prices side by side.

sections.h2: 2. Check whether a screen is already included
parts: Two listings come with a screen: the Performance V700G Pro ($429.99) and the Leisure 570B ($239.99). Buying the V700G ($298.00) and the StayTrue 120" screen ($129.99) separately adds up to $427.99, almost the same as the V700G Pro, which is brighter (730 against 400 lumens). With the code, the V700G Pro is $386.99.
If you already have a white wall or a screen, skip the bundles and buy the projector on its own.

sections.h2: 3. Skip the bag bundle unless you'll carry it
parts: The H500R costs $199.99 alone and $249.99 with a carrying bag, so the bag adds $50 ($45 after the code). It's worth it only if you plan to take the projector to other rooms, trips or backyard movie nights.

sections.h2: 4. Add accessories in the same order
parts: Some accessories were marked down on November 16, 2026: the ceiling mount at $24.99 (shown against $29.99) and the remote for the Leisure 570B, 570D and 570S at $19.99 (shown against $29.99). Adding the mount or the TP20 tripod to the same order puts them under the same {pct} code and the same free shipping.

VANKYO's shipping policy (updated July 29, 2026) gives free standard shipping on eligible ivankyo.com orders to the contiguous United States. It doesn't ship to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, US territories or APO, FPO and DPO addresses. Most in-stock orders arrive within 3 to 7 business days, and orders aren't usually processed or shipped on weekends or holidays.

Eligible products can be returned within 30 calendar days of delivery, including for a change of mind, but you must contact customer support first and the return has to include all accessories and the original packaging where possible. If VANKYO confirms a defect, damage or a wrong item, it covers reasonable return shipping. For change-of-mind returns you pay return shipping, and original shipping charges are generally not refunded. Projectors carry a one-year warranty from the purchase date. Products bought on Amazon, Walmart or other sellers go back through that seller.
